title: Space Cadet Access
description:
3D Pinball for Windows - Space Cadet, playable by ear with a screen reader. It plays audio cues for when a ball comes near the flippers, when the ball is ready to launch and more, makes all the menus accessible, allows event browsing with Ctrl+arrows, and announces all the in-game text. The ball is a tone that moves left and right with it, its pitch showing the height on the table.

Built on the SpaceCadetPinball decompilation by k4zmu2a. 3D Pinball for Windows - Space Cadet is by Cinematronics and Microsoft.
